Blender Rigger & Animator — CBX (Remote)
We're looking for a skilled Blender Rigger & Animator to help rig and animate detailed hard-surface vehicles and mechanical assets for cinematic 3D videos.
Responsibilities
- Rig complex hard-surface and mechanical assets in Blender
- Create clean control systems for moving components
- Rig rotating, folding, extending, opening and articulated parts
- Set up constraints, parenting and mechanical relationships correctly
- Animate mechanical sequences with realistic timing and movement
- Create animations for components such as rotors, propellers, doors, landing systems, engines, wheels and other moving assemblies
- Troubleshoot existing rigs and improve them where necessary
- Keep rigs organized and easy for other artists to use
- Prepare clean Blender files for integration into the wider production pipeline
Requirements
- Strong experience with Blender rigging and animation
- Excellent understanding of constraints, drivers, parenting and rig controls
- Experience rigging hard-surface vehicles, machinery or complex mechanical objects
- Strong understanding of mechanical movement and how different components interact
- Ability to create realistic and polished animation
- Clean and organized Blender workflow
- Able to work independently from references and technical instructions
- Good communication and ability to deliver within agreed deadlines
Nice to Have
- Experience with Unreal Engine pipelines
- Experience preparing rigs or animations for export
- Familiarity with cinematic animation
- Experience working with highly detailed production assets
Experience: Rigging: 2 years (Preferred)
